name: What should I consider before scheduling an accessible bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider before scheduling an accessible bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting an accessible remodel, consider the specific mobility aids used, door clearance into the room, and daily movement paths. Note whether the primary user relies on a walker, manual wheelchair, power chair, or assistance from a caregiver, as this dictates turning radiuses and shower seat placement. Measure adjacent hallway widths to determine whether a standard swinging door or a pocket door works better. Deciding on necessary fixture heights and shower wand reaches early ensures framing, plumbing rough-ins, and electrical outlets are placed accurately before tile work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Identify specific mobility equipment used, required turning space, preferred fixture heights, and whether doorways need widening or pocket-door conversions.
